description:
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Office of Regulatory Testing and Surveillance (ORTS) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to gather information from qualified contractors capable of providing preventive maintenance, calibration, and repair services for VITEK laboratory systems across multiple FDA laboratory locations.

Responses to this RFI should be submitted electronically to Nina Montgomery; nina.montgomery@fda.hhs.gov no later than March 11, 2026 at 10:00AM (EST). Please reference the RFI number in the subject line.
